name: GstPipelineStudio
blurb: GstPipelineStudio aims to provide a graphical user interface to the GStreamer framework.
description: GstPipelineStudio aims to provide a graphical user interface to the GStreamer framework. From a first step in the framework with a simple pipeline to a complex pipeline debugging, the tool provides a friendly interface to add elements to a pipeline and debug it.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
